IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: THE MISSION OF THE AMERICAN COUNCIL ON EXERCISE (ACE) IS TO GET PEOPLE MOVING.
IRS990.MissionDesc: ACE WORKS TO IMPROVE PHYSICAL-ACTIVITY LEVELS BY EDUCATING EXERCISE PROFESSIONALS AND HEALTH COACHES, FUNDING ORIGINAL RESEARCH, AND COLLABORATING WITH EXPERTS ON PHYSICAL ACTIVITY AND HEALTH TO GET PEOPLE FROM ALL WALKS OF LIFE MOVING.
IRS990.Desc: CONTINUING EDUCATION AND RENEWALS: ACE DEVELOPED AND UPDATED APPROXIMATELY 40 EDUCATION PROGRAMS AND COURSES, INCLUDING THE ACE HEALTH AND WELLNESS SUMMIT: A HOLISTIC APPROACH TO MENTAL HEALTH AND MINDFUL MOVEMENT: COACHING CLIENTS TO BECOME MORE ACTIVE. EXERCISE PROFESSIONALS AND HEALTH COACHES ARE ABLE TO RENEW THEIR CERTIFICATIONS WITH ACE THROUGH CONTENT BY ACE AND ITS APPROVED PARTNERS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: CERTIFICATION AND PREPARATORY EDUCATION:THE EDUCATION OF WELL-QUALIFIED EXERCISE PROFESSIONALS AND HEALTH COACHES IS THE FOUNDATION OF THE ACE APPROACH TO GET PEOPLE MOVING. ACE DEVELOPS, REVIEWS, AND MAINTAINS EDUCATIONAL RESOURCES, STUDY MATERIALS AND TRAINING MANUALS AND RELATED EXAMS. IN THE PAST YEAR, THE NUMBER OF ACE CERTIFIED PROFESSIONALS INCLUDED 50,031 ACE CERTIFIED PERSONAL TRAINERS; 20,396 ACE CERTIFIED GROUP FITNESS INSTRUCTORS; 5,817 ACE CERTIFIED HEALTH COACHES; 824 ACE CERTIFIED MEDICAL EXERCISE SPECIALISTS. COLLECTIVELY, ACE CERTIFIED PROFESSIONALS HELD APPROXIMATELY 10.5 MILLION CLIENT AND GROUP SESSIONS IN THE PAST YEAR.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: OUTREACH:ACE CONTINUES TO PROVIDE THE PUBLIC WITH SCIENCE-BASED INFORMATION TO EDUCATE AND ENCOURAGE PEOPLE FROM ALL WALKS OF LIFE TO ACHIEVE SUSTAINABLE HEALTH CHANGES. IN THE PAST YEAR, ACE INVESTED IN ORIGINAL RESEARCH, INCLUDING YOUTH SPORT COACHES' KNOWLEDGE OF EXERCISE PHYSIOLOGY AND RELATED CONCEPTS. IN ADDITION, ACE CREATED THE FOUNDATIONS FOR COMMUNITY PHYSICAL ACTIVITY LEADERS, A FREE ONLINE COURSE DESIGNED TO EDUCATE AND EMPOWER COMMUNITY MEMBERS SEEKING TO GET THEIR COMMUNITIES MORE ACTIVE.PHYSICAL ACTIVITY PROMOTION:ACE REMAINS COMMITTED TO PROVIDING THE PUBLIC, FITNESS ENTHUSIASTS, HEALTH PROFESSIONALS AND CERTIFIED PROFESSIONALS WITH FREE, SCIENCE-BASED CONTENT TO SUPPORT MORE ACTIVE AND HEALTHIER LIFESTYLES. IN THE PAST YEAR, ACE AUTHORED MORE THAN 200 FREE ARTICLES ON PHYSICAL ACTIVITY TIPS AND EDUCATION, WHICH COVERED TOPICS SUCH AS ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE, OBESITY MEDICATIONS, MENTAL HEALTH AND WELLNESS, AND HEALTHSPAN AND LONGEVITY. IN ADDITION, ACE COORDINATED 2,288UNIQUE NEWS STORIES AND OPINION EDITORIALS TO INSPIRE AND ENOURAGE PHYSICAL ACTIVITY.ACE ALSO PARTNERED WITH LIKE-MINDED ORGANIZATIONS TO PROMOTE SUSTAINABLE HEALTHIER LIVING, INCLUDING ITS PARTNERSHIP WITH THE AMERICAN COLLEGE OF LIFESTYLE MEDICINE WHICH SOUGHT TO TRAIN FEDERALLY QUALIFIED HEALTH CENTER PHYSICIANS. ACE ALSO PARTNERED WITH THE LAKESHORE FOUNDATION, THE PHYSICAL ACTIVITY ALLIANCE, AND THE COALITION FOR THE REGISTRATION OF EXERCISE PROFESSIONALS. ACE SERVED AS MULTIPLE BOARDS AND COMMITTEES TO PROMOTE PHYSICAL ACTIVITY, INCLUDING THE FORBES HEALTH MEDICAL ADVISORY BOARD, THE ROUNDTABLE ON OBESITY SOLUTIONS, THE PHYSICAL ACTIVITY AND HEALTH INNOVATION COLLABORATIVE AND THE U.S. NEWS & WORLD REPORT MEDICAL REVIEW BOARD.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS REVIEWED INTERNALLY BY THE EXECUTIVE TEAM AND EXTERNALLY BY THE AUDIT COMMITTEE. THE FORM 990 IS MADE AVAILABLE TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS PRIOR TO SUBMISSION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ALL BOARD MEMBERS AND ACE STAFF ARE REQUIRED TO ANNUALLY COMPLETE A CONFLICT OF INTEREST DISCLOSURE FORM. THE BOARD REVIEWS ALL BOARD MEMBER DISCLOSURES AS WELL AS THE CEO AND CFO. CEO AND CFO REVIEW ACE EMPLOYEE DISCLOSURES. AT EACH BOARD MEETING, MEMBERS ARE REMINDED OF CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICIES AND ASKED IF THEY ARE AWARE OF ANY CONFLICTS. IF A CONFLICT ARISES, THAT BOARD MEMBER CANNOT VOTE ON THE MATTER.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: WITH RESPECT TO THE CEO AND OFFICERS (PRESIDENT & CHIEF OPERATIONS OFFICER AND CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER), A COMPENSATION ANALYSIS IS PERFORMED BY AN INDEPENDENT PARTY WHICH TAKES MARKET DATA FROM SEVERAL PUBLISHED SURVEYS AND MARKET PRICES FOR THE POSITIONS BASED ON JOB RESPONSIBILITIES AND CORPORATE INFORMATION. TOTAL COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS ARE INCLUDED IN THE REVIEW. THE COMPENSATION COMMITTEE REVIEWS THE REPORT AND MAKES RECOMMENDATIONS TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS. COMPENSATION IS APPROVED BY INDEPENDENT BOARD MEMBERS AND IS CONTEMPORANEOUSLY DOCUMENTED. THIS PROCESS WAS LAST DONE JUNE 2025 DURING THE ANNUAL BOARD MEETING. A COMPENSATION ANALYSIS IS PERFORMED BY AN INDEPENDENT PARTY ANNUALLY WHICH TAKES MARKET DATA FROM SEVERAL PUBLISHED SURVEYS AND MARKET PRICES ALL OF OUR STAFF INCLUDING KEY EMPLOYEE POSITIONS BASED ON JOB RESPONSIBILITIES AND CORPORATE INFORMATION. THE CFO AND CEO REVIEW THE REPORT AND MAKE RECOMMENDATIONS TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS. COMPENSATION FOR KEY EMPLOYEES AND STAFF ARE APPROVED DURING THE BUDGETED PROCESS BY INDEPENDENT BOARD MEMBERS AND IS CONTEMPORANEOUSLY DOCUMENTED. THIS PROCESS WAS LAST DONE IN JUNE 2025 DURING THE ANNUAL BOARD MEETING.
